description: This file manages authentication profile storage, including loading, saving, merging, and handling credentials for different agents. It interacts with the filesystem, handles legacy formats, and synchronizes external CLI credentials.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeStoreKey
methods.description: Generates a key for runtime auth store snapshots based on agent directory.

methods.name: cloneAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of an AuthProfileStore object.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Retrieves a cloned auth profile store for a given agent directory, merging if necessary.

methods.name: replaceRuntimeAuthProfileStoreSnapshots
methods.description: Replaces current runtime auth store snapshots with provided entries.

methods.name: clearRuntimeAuthProfileStoreSnapshots
methods.description: Clears all runtime auth store snapshots and cache.

methods.name: readAuthStoreMtimeMs
methods.description: Reads the modification time of the auth store file.

methods.name: readCachedAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Returns a cached auth profile store if valid and not stale.

methods.name: writeCachedAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Stores a clone of the auth profile store in cache with current timestamp.

methods.name: normalizeSecretBackedField
methods.description: Normalizes secret reference fields in credential entries.

methods.name: updateAuthProfileStoreWithLock
methods.description: Updates the auth profile store with a lock to prevent concurrent modifications.

methods.name: normalizeRawCredentialEntry
methods.description: Normalizes raw credential entries, handling legacy field names and secret references.

methods.name: parseCredentialEntry
methods.description: Validates and parses raw credential entries into structured credentials.

methods.name: warnRejectedCredentialEntries
methods.description: Logs warnings for rejected credential entries during store loading.

methods.name: coerceLegacyStore
methods.description: Converts legacy auth JSON format into current store format.

methods.name: coerceAuthStore
methods.description: Converts raw JSON into a structured AuthProfileStore, validating entries.

methods.name: mergeRecord
methods.description: Merges two record objects, with override taking precedence.

methods.name: mergeAuthProfileStores
methods.description: Merges two AuthProfileStore objects, combining profiles and other fields.

methods.name: buildPersistedAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Prepares an AuthProfileStore for persistence, sanitizing sensitive fields.

methods.name: mergeOAuthFileIntoStore
methods.description: Merges OAuth credentials from external JSON file into the store.

methods.name: applyLegacyStore
methods.description: Applies legacy credential data into the current store format.

methods.name: loadCoercedStore
methods.description: Loads and coerces the auth store JSON file into structured data.

methods.name: shouldLogAuthStoreTiming
methods.description: Checks environment variable to determine if timing logs should be emitted.

methods.name: syncExternalCliCredentialsTimed
methods.description: Synchronizes external CLI credentials with optional timing logging.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Loads the main auth profile store, handling legacy formats and external sync.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStoreForAgent
methods.description: Loads auth profile store for a specific agent directory, with inheritance fallback.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStoreForRuntime
methods.description: Loads auth profile store for runtime, merging main and agent stores.

methods.name: loadAuthProfileStoreForSecretsRuntime
methods.description: Loads auth profile store in read-only mode for secrets handling.

methods.name: ensureAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Ensures a valid auth profile store is available, merging main and agent stores if needed.

methods.name: saveAuthProfileStore
methods.description: Saves the auth profile store to disk and updates runtime snapshots.
